channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, AI, Tech & Research, EU, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, AI, Tech & Research, EU, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 3 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Mondriaan Fund: International Collaborative Projects with Heritage Institutes (September 2026 round)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/international-collaborative-projects-with-heritage-institutes/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline 10 Sep 2026 · Determined per application. Up to 40% of variable project costs. For a development research phase, up to 70% of variable costs capped at EUR 15,000, covering travel, accommodation and presentation costs. The applicant must contribute significantly to the project financing, and the international partners' cost share must be proportional to the Mondriaan Fund grant. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Heritage Innovation (September 2026 round)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/heritage-innovation/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline 17 Sep 2026 · Projects: up to 40% of variable project-related costs, with a minimum project budget of EUR 25,000. Research tracks: up to 70% of costs, capped at EUR 15,000, with no minimum budget. No application fee.
  • Trust me, I'm an AI/rtist: Open Call for Creative Interventions
    https://waag.org/en/article/open-call-creative-interventions-trust-me-im-airtist/
    Waag Futurelab (Horizon Europe project HAMLET) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 20,000 commission fee excluding VAT, inclusive of artist fee, travel, accommodation and production costs. Applicants must have a VAT number in Europe. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• KNOWCASE Open Call 2027: permanent digital-culture installation in Madrid (Sonar+D x Fundacion Cotec)
    https://sonar.es/en/news/knowcase-open-call-2027
    Fundacion Cotec and Sonar+D · deadline 07 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 100,000 (plus VAT), all-inclusive: conceptualisation, design, technical development, production, installation, maintenance, documentation, artist fees, travel, accommodation and insurance.
  • Cultuurloket DigitALL: Implementation Contribution (Implementatiebijdrage, 2026)
    https://cultuurloketdigitall.nl/implementatiebijdrage/
    Cultuurloket DigitALL · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Up to EUR 30,000. Covers technical modification, system integration, production and deployment costs. Hardware purchase alone is ineligible unless clearly essential to the public experience. No stated co-financing percentage. No application fee.
  • Cultuurloket DigitALL: Pilot Contribution (Pilotbijdrage, 2026-2027, rolling)
    https://cultuurloketdigitall.nl/pilotbijdrage/
    Cultuurloket DigitALL (successor to Kickstart Cultuurfonds) · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to EUR 75,000. Covers pilot development, audience testing, and knowledge development or training via partner organisations if budgeted. Hardware-only purchases are not eligible. No stated co-financing percentage. No application fee. Annual donation budget of EUR 1.9 million in 2026 and 2027.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research grant - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• transmediale x Pro Helvetia Digital Art Residency 2027
    https://transmediale.de/en/news/digital-art-residency-2027
    transmediale (in cooperation with the Swiss Arts Council Pro Helvetia) · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · Artist fee of CHF 2,000 per month across the two-month residency (CHF 4,000), plus a production grant of CHF 15,000 for the selected project, plus travel and accommodation for both the festival and the residency month. Duos and collectives may apply but the fee and the production grant stay the same and must be shared. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research grant - week of 20 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Building Narrative Power: EUR 2m funding and learning programme
    https://europeanaifund.org/newspublications/call-for-proposals-new-e2m-building-narrative-power-funding-and-learning-programme/
    European AI & Society Fund · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Grants of up to EUR 150,000 from a EUR 2 million programme, plus a place in the accompanying learning programme and community of practice. Payments are usually 50% on grant signing, 40% midway through the grant period subject to previous funds having been spent, and 10% on completion. As a general rule organisations should not request more than their previous annual budget unless the need is motivated and demonstrated; without a previous annual budget, request an amount proportional to the project. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 15 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Musikfonds: STIP-6 AI Scholarship Programme 2027 (Germany)
    https://www.musikfonds.de/foerderprogramme
    musikfonds e.V. · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · EUR 30,000 lump sum per scholarship, paid in twelve monthly installments across January to December 2027. Ten scholarships available. No application fee.
  • Eurostars Call 11 2026 (Eureka / Eurostars-3)
    https://www.eurekanetwork.org/programmes-and-calls/eurostars/eurostars-call-for-projects-september-2026/
    Eureka / Eurostars-3 (Dutch participation via RVO) · deadline 10 Sep 2026 · Co-funds collaborative international R&D; national funding varies by country. For the Dutch project share: up to EUR 500,000 per project at 50 percent reimbursement of eligible R&D costs. No application fee.
  • MIT R&D Collaboration Projects 2026 (MKB Innovatiestimulering Topsectoren)
    https://www.rvo.nl/subsidies-financiering/mit/rd-samenwerkingsprojecten
    Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Grant covering 35 percent of eligible costs. Small projects EUR 50,000-200,000; large projects EUR 200,000-350,000 per project (EUR 25,000-100,000 or EUR 25,000-175,000 per participant). No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 08 Jun 2026
item.description:
• EIC Accelerator 2026 (European Innovation Council)
    https://eic.ec.europa.eu/eic-funding-opportunities/eic-accelerator_en
    European Innovation Council (European Commission) · deadline Closed 08 Jul 2026 · Grant up to EUR 2.5 million (non-dilutive lump sum) for innovation activities, plus optional equity investment of EUR 1-10 million via the EIC Fund. Options: grant-only, blended finance, or investment-only. No application fee.
  • Stimuleringsfonds: Digital Culture Grant Scheme 2026 (final round)
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/digital-culture-grant-scheme
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) · deadline Closed 19 Aug 2026 · EUR 10,000-25,000 for solo projects; EUR 10,000-50,000 for collaborative projects with partners. At least 20 percent of total project costs must be covered by co-financing. No application fee.
  • Prototype Fund Switzerland 2026-27: Responsible and Sustainable AI
    https://prototypefund.opendata.ch/en/
    Prototype Fund Switzerland (Opendata.ch) · deadline 07 Sep 2026 · Up to CHF 50,000 per project, plus coaching, mentoring and workshops and access to a tech/policy/society network. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research grant - week of 27 Apr 2026
item.description:
• Marie Skłodowska-Curie Postdoctoral Fellowships 2026 (MSCA-PF)
    https://marie-sklodowska-curie-actions.ec.europa.eu/funding/msca-postdoctoral-fellowships-2026
    European Commission (Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions, under Horizon Europe; managed by the European Research Executive Agency, REA) · deadline 09 Sep 2026 · Standard MSCA unit costs covering researcher allowance (living, mobility, family), research/training/networking costs and management/indirect costs (annual values published in the call's Work Programme; typically a fully-funded postdoc package of roughly €5,000 to €8,000+ per researcher per month equivalent depending on host country correction coefficient)
